identification: Small copper and brass box lantern, roughly 30cm, bevelled glass side panels, round hinged reflector door, pierced vents, oil burner. Probably a railway, ship or signal lamp of c1890-1920; no maker plate seen, British military attribution unconfirmed. Two bevelled panels cracked.

viewing_check: Look for any stamped maker or broad arrow marks on the body, burner, reflector door or inside the top; check whether the reflector is silvered and original; measure height; check that the burner is complete and that the cracked glass is only two panels.
